headline: Indiabulls Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Indiabulls Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of 70% of the issued, subscribed and paid-up equity share capital of the Fintech Cloud Private Limited and execution of definitive agreement, in this regard.
